en: Added `auth: { google: {} }` for Claude apps gateway `telemetry.forward_to` destinations, so telemetry can be exported straight to Google Cloud's OTLP endpoint using the gateway's Google Cloud credentials
zh: 为 Claude 应用网关的 `telemetry.forward_to` 目标新增 `auth: { google: {} }`，可使用网关的 Google Cloud 凭据将遥测直接导出到 Google Cloud 的 OTLP 端点
